places.name: Harcourt Estate
places.summary: An old noble estate divided between public ceremony and guarded private wings.
places.details: The oldest passages predate the current floor plan.

places.name: East dressing room
places.summary: A private dressing room adjoining the old ceremonial gallery.
places.details: A heavy cabinet covers part of the original wall paneling.
places.atmosphere: Stale perfume, dust, and carefully maintained order.

places.name: Private corridor
places.summary: A narrow corridor linking the family's private rooms.
places.details: Servants use concealed cross-passages behind the paneling.
places.atmosphere: Quiet enough that every footstep carries.
